comment: E7.WINDOWS.1 (owner decision D2): the exact inputs a Windows package is built from. The hApps and game UI are the verified Linux release v0.3's bytes (never rebuilt on Windows); the licence inputs are generated on Linux for the Windows target. scripts/prepare-windows-inputs.mjs (Linux) and scripts/build-windows.mjs (Windows) refuse anything that differs. Change only together with a deliberate new release.

source_release.name: turbo-kart-demo-v0.3-internet-stability
source_release.verified: 2026-10-12: SHA256SUMS of the release checked OK; gaming_platform.happ, kangaroo.happ and expected-dna-hashes.json extracted from the .deb are byte-identical to the pins below; turbo_kart.webhapp equals the sha256 the v0.3 manifest records

kangaroo.happ.note: unpacked from turbo_kart.webhapp by `yarn pouch:unpack`; not shipped separately

ui.digest_rule: sha256 of the lines '<sha256>  ./<path>\n' for every file under resources/ui, ordered by path. bytewise: byte order (C locale, reproducible on every OS). en_US: `sort -z` under en_US.UTF-8, the value tk-demo.sh printed for v0.3. Same 66 files.

licences.note: RUST-CRATES.txt lists the sidecar's crates for x86_64-pc-windows-msvc plus the zomes' (cargo tree --target, offline, locked). NPM-PACKAGES.txt, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, electron-LICENSE.txt and manifest.json are generated on Windows from the installed packages.

native_binaries.comment: Downloaded by scripts/fetch-binaries.js and checked against kangaroo.config.ts; these equal the 'digest' GitHub publishes for the holochain-0.7.0 release assets (checked 2026-10-12). Upstream ships them unsigned and dynamically linked to VCRUNTIME140.dll.
